title: Amazing Herbal Moroccan Kiwifruit Chebakia
description: A traditional Moroccan chebakia dish infused with herbal flavors and featuring kiwifruit, perfect for a flexitarian snack or dessert. This sweet and shattering treat is also known to help cure hangovers.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the almond flour, sesame seeds, ginger powder, and cinnamon powder.
In a separate bowl, mix together the honey, orange blossom water, and rose water.
Add the diced kiwifruit to the honey mixture and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Using a spoon, drop small balls of the almond flour mixture into the oil and fry until golden brown.
Drain the fried chebakia on paper towels and then dip them into the honey and kiwifruit mixture.
Serve the chebakia warm and enjoy.
Store any leftovers in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 3 days.
Reheat the chebakia in the oven at 300 degrees Fahrenheit for 5 minutes before serving.
